gloss: pass or fail; success or failure (in an exam)

definitions.gloss: pass or fail; result (of an exam or selection)
definitions.explanation: Whether someone passes or fails an examination, audition or other selection; also the decision itself.

examples.japanese: {合否|ごうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧。
{合否|ごうひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧わかる。
examples.english: I'll find out next week whether I passed.

examples.japanese: {合否|ごうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦されます→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Applicants will be notified of the result by email.

notes:
⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧ from ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧ (passing) + {否|ひ} (no). A formal word used by schools, companies and testing bodies; in conversation people ask ⟦{受|う}かった→受かる：19367_ukaru⟧？ or ⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧？

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合否|ごうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to decide pass or fail
- {合否|ごうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to decide who passes (of a question, a point)
- {合否|ごうひ}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: announcement of results
- {合否|ごうひ}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: notice of the result
